C2/C5/saved composition is repeated for bounded scalar candidates and prefix trials before completion dedup. More incoming decoder rows and deeper paths multiply consumer checks rather than merely adding proportional physical work.
interpretation.causalLimit: No serialized full demand inventory per scope/port, no persistent RecordStore census per iteration, and no full Stirling LoopPipelineTrace are captured. First-path samples prove observed path patterns, not exact producer instruction chains or complete output packets. Cannot assign every extra handoff row to one path family or prove schedule independence from these logs.

countCaveats: Physical maximum-depth/kind bins are exhaustive packet-event counters, not retained set cardinalities.
Sampled path list retains the final64 sampled events per method; first16 and every1024th event are sampled, with no claim of unbiased distribution.

counterDefinitions.c5PlanOccurrences: K: checked row/member occurrences included in successfully built prepared plans; failed factory prefixes are not necessarily included.
counterDefinitions.c5AcceptedOccurrences: k: accepted entry tickets in successfully built plans; accepted entry-only/no-output occurrences may not produce programs.
counterDefinitions.c5OutputPrograms: s: distinct exact output programs across successfully built plans; not unique across different plan contexts.
counterDefinitions.c5ProgramQueries: Prepared plan intersections, including empty-base answers and queries that later overflow and fall back.
counterDefinitions.c5PacketStreams: Native protected/ordinary stream traversals in the prepared path, not unique packets.
counterDefinitions.c5ScalarEnumerations: Scalar mark/path memberships visited in prepared stream traversals; may include work discarded on overflow.
counterDefinitions.c5ProgramCandidates: Scalar/program candidate pairs visited after output index selection.
counterDefinitions.c5SelectedReferences: Distinct per-program/per-stream selected Conclusions inserted into query-local buckets.
counterDefinitions.c5SelectedReferencePeak: Maximum selected references in one query, not an additive total; may include the overflow-triggering reference.
counterDefinitions.c5BucketFallbacks: Prepared queries whose selected-reference bound is exceeded; native full query recomputes after partial pure work is discarded.
counterDefinitions.c5StreamPacks: Whole-program protected/ordinary stream packing operations, not per-leaf cuts.
counterDefinitions.c5RowAttempts: CHANGED: prepared output-program finalizations plus native/fallback row-packet attempts. Do not compare directly with old all-row call counts.
counterDefinitions.c5PlanFallback*: Factory fallback reason counts, not total native executions through cached negative plans.
counterDefinitions.prePublicationLocalOffers: Actual LocalVar raw-summary gate invocations; distinct from prepared cache entries and later local-boundary tests.
counterDefinitions.prePublicationDeadLocals: Raw-summary gate invocations returning DeadData; repeated invocations are not unique dropped facts.
counterDefinitions.preparedExitEntries: Prepared route cache entries, not raw-summary invocations.
counterDefinitions.preparedExitTargetMasks: Built local target masks; dynamic ActualStarts is still intersected at use.
counterDefinitions.localPublicationLinearPairs: Arithmetic row/input/member all-pairs bound, not proof every prior version executed every native predicate.
counterDefinitions.savedOutputPositions: Positional saved-reader selections; positions sharing a record still retain their ordinals.

sourceBackedFindings.name: Sparse selection followed by dense program drain
sourceBackedFindings.behavior: Trie queries fill sparse ordinal buckets; final for(program in programs) still visits every eligible output program, including null buckets. A null bucket increments c5ExactRejectRows but runs no native restrict predicate. Same-program candidates merge/protection-pack before field cut.
sourceBackedFindings.measuredSupport: R5 321261307 total row finalizations/native attempts;302575905 rejected. 18694131 prepared trie scalar/program candidates,18537366 selected references. Aggregate logging cannot partition exact rejected count between null prepared buckets and native restriction failures.
sourceBackedFindings.candidate: Finalize only nonempty buckets ordered by original program.ordinal, preserving per-program stream order, whole packet cuts, protection and ExactDemandResults output merging. Native fallback stays unchanged.

sourceBackedFindings.name: R5 dense eligibility
sourceBackedFindings.behavior: Plans prepare exact whole-original/entry/exit/policy contexts and deduplicate outputs after checking each paired row/member occurrence. Bounded32 quantum cache can rebuild after quantum or capacity reset.
sourceBackedFindings.measuredSupport: R5 replaceList48674 plans31562162 occurrence checks179 live groups. This proves many checks per plan and many preparations, not identical-context duplication; exact per-key history/quantum boundary absent.
sourceBackedFindings.candidate: Separate stable fixed-context paired-row eligibility from per-result scalar selection, with exact native normalization/ports/mark/exclusion semantics. First measure unique plan keys and reset reasons, do not assume global memo hit rate.

limits: Counts include root+block scopes and controls under original MethodKey. No missing-scoped-count explanation.
admitted/outgoing RelationCensus fields already include block* subsets. Public values derived by subtraction; annotations are not normalized unique DemandStore rows.
Alternating forward/backward frontier counts are different relation directions, not a monotonic superset test.
Hot-owner counters cover only loggedtop24, not all loop methods. Absent owner means unknown.
Final frontier DEBUG maps contain counts only; per-row mark/field/layer payloads are not available. Census and samples support predominance/shape, not an exact bijection of newly added rows.
Rawsamples only first branch/bounded marks; exact4096 diagnostic belongs separate stopped capture, not whole main run.
No exact repeated-plan-key count, unique native result count, CPU time by owner or sound elimination of generic field-model branches is established.
No new JVM/analyzer/profiler run; no runtime or repository edits.
